examplePrompt:
An employee submits a purchase request in the portal with justification and a cost estimate. The manager reviews the request within two business days.

If the manager approves, they forward the case to procurement. Procurement obtains at least two quotes and selects a vendor. If the total amount exceeds 10,000 euros, executive management must approve as well. After approval, procurement creates the purchase order and notifies the employee by email.

If the manager rejects the request, the employee receives a notification with the reason and may revise and resubmit the request.

After goods are shipped, inbound inspection confirms receipt in the system. If the delivery matches the order, accounting closes the case. If quantity or items differ, inbound inspection escalates to procurement to clarify with the vendor.
